name.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party

alias.title: alias
alias.description: Alias name of the party used for identification.

resolved_name.description: Actual account name of the party resolved by backend system.

owner_type.description: Describes the type of party who owns the respective proxy/alias, either an Individual(NATURAL_PERSON) or Corporate(LEGAL_PERSON)

tax_id.description: Tax identification number of the party.

country_code.description: Country where the request is initiated for beneficiary account search/validation in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

bank_code.description: Bank identification code of the party used for identification of a financial institution

branch_id.title: branch_id
branch_id.description: Branch identification identification code of the party used for identification of a financial institution

account_id.title: account_id
account_id.description: Account number of the party as provided in the Input API request

proxy_type.title: proxy_type
proxy_type.description: Type of the proxy value used for validation/search

proxy_value.title: proxy_value
proxy_value.description: Actual proxy value related to the proxy type used for validation/search

account_currency.title: account_currency
account_currency.description:
Identification of the currency in which the account is held.

Single & mMltiple account currency is supported which are seperated by comma.

account_opening_date.title: account_opening_date
account_opening_date.description: Date to identify when the Account is Operationally available for business transactions in business date format YYYYMMDD

trade_name.title: trade_name
trade_name.description: Describes the trade name of the party who owns the respective proxy/alias

document_type.title: document_type
document_type.description:
Name of Tax ID based on the country

Example - Tax ID for Peru is 'RUC'.

document_number.title: document_number
document_number.description: Unique Tax Identification number of the party.

account_verification_status.title: account_verification_status
account_verification_status.description: Account status details received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

account_verification_description.title: account_verification_description
account_verification_description.description: Account status description details received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

account_owner_status.title: account_owner_status
account_owner_status.description: Account status details received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

account_owner_description.title: account_owner_description
account_owner_description.description: Account status description details received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

firstname.title: firstname
firstname.description: Beneficiary First Name verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

lastname.title: lastname
lastname.description: Beneficiary Last Name verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

dob.title: dob
dob.description: Beneficiary date of birth verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

address_line1.title: address_line1
address_line1.description: Beneficiary Address line1 verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

address_line2.title: address_line2
address_line2.description: Beneficiary Address line2 verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

city.title: city
city.description: Beneficiary city verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

state.title: state
state.description: Beneficiary city verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

zip.title: zip
zip.description: Beneficiary zipcode verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

home_phone.title: home_phone
home_phone.description: Beneficiary home phone number verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

work_phone.title: work_phone
work_phone.description: Beneficiary work phone number verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

id_type.title: id_type
id_type.description: Beneficiary identification type verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

id_no.title: id_no
id_no.description: Beneficiary identification number verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

id_issuanceplace.title: id_issuanceplace
id_issuanceplace.description: Beneficiary identification issuance place verification response received from Early Warning Systems (EWS).

additional_information.title: additional_information
additional_information.description: Additional information received in the payload request for Early Warning Systems (EWS).

creditor_name.title: creditor_name
creditor_name.description:
Account name of the creditor intended for search/validation whose payment amount will be credited.
For early warning system (EWS), if the verification_type = (BANKOWN or BASICVR) either creditor_firstname & creditor_lastname or creditor_name (Business Name) should be passed. Business name maximum allowed length 87 characters.

end_to_end_id.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unambiguously identify the transaction which can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the transaction. It can be included in several messages related to the transaction.

value_date.description: Requested execution date post alias resolution when the payment needs to be processed for settlement, format would be YYYYMMDD.

proxy_status.description: Describes the status of Alias/Proxy - whether Active, Inactive or Deleted

banelco_flag.description: Flag will be 'Y' for successfull search/validation & 'N' for failure case.

clearing_system_id.title: clearing_system_id
clearing_system_id.description: Unique reference, as assigned by a clearing system.

lookup_reference.description: unique reference number of the request.This is e2e tracking reference from CCD. It will be provided by Concord.

lookup_response_status.description: status(SUCCESS / FAILURE) of the request and get processed successfully. If account exist then status is SUCCESS else FAILURE.

status_code.description: Response status of validation-Complete with data from Status Validation.

status_message.description: Response message of validation-Complete with data from Message Validation.
